stories.title: Riña en penal de Mazatlán deja seis muertos y 15 heridos; Guardia Nacional ingresa a controlar la situación

en.title: Prison riot in Mazatlán leaves six dead and 15 wounded; National Guard enters to control situation
en.summary: A violent altercation at a Mazatlán penitentiary resulted in six deaths and 15 injuries. Army and National Guard personnel increased security outside the facility while inmates' relatives sought information.

stories.title: Reportan disparos y riña en penal de Mazatlán; suspenden visitas y despliegan operativo

en.title: Gunfire and riot reported in Mazatlán prison; visits suspended and operation deployed
en.summary: A conflict between inmates at Mazatlán prison allegedly triggered gunfire. Authorities launched an operational response and halted visiting access to the facility.

stories.title: Fisco presume que finanzas públicas se han despetrolizado sin reforma fiscal

en.title: Tax agency reports that public finances have reduced oil dependence without tax reform
en.summary: Mexico's tax collection agency indicated that tax revenues serve as the backbone of public spending, with budgeted expenditures set at 10.6 trillion pesos for the following year.

stories.title: Sin reforma fiscal se han “despetrolizado” los ingresos en México: SAT; contribuyentes sufragan el gasto público, dice

en.title: Without tax reform, Mexico's revenues have become "less oil-dependent": SAT; taxpayers fund public spending, it says
en.summary: Mexico's tax authority stated that tax collection has grown as a share of GDP since 2018 without raising tax rates or introducing new taxes.

stories.title: Zar antidrogas de EU lanza amenaza a políticos que colaboren con los cárteles mexicanos; "no nos importa si eres gobernador", advierte

en.title: US drug czar threatens politicians who collaborate with Mexican cartels; "we don't care if you're a governor," warns
en.summary: Sara Carter, head of the US National Drug Control Policy Office, warned that criminals will not be able to live peacefully, threatening politicians at all levels who work with Mexican cartels.

stories.title: Reportan disparos dentro del penal de Mazatlán; despliegan operativo federal y estatal

en.title: Gunfire reported inside Mazatlán prison; federal and state operation deployed
en.summary: Authorities deployed federal and state operations after reports of gunfire inside a Mazatlán prison, reportedly from a confrontation between rival inmate groups.

stories.title: ¿Dónde comprar los libros de Anne Carson?; estos son sus títulos clave tras ganar el Nobel

en.title: Where to buy Anne Carson's books?; these are her key titles after winning the Nobel
en.summary: Canadian writer Anne Carson won the Nobel Prize in Literature, recognized for her revolutionary literary career and body of work.

stories.title: Realizan operativo ante disparos en penal de Mazatlán

en.title: Operation conducted following gunfire at Mazatlán prison
en.summary: Police deployed a significant mobilization at a Mazatlán prison facility in response to reports of gunfire inside the facility.

stories.title: Anne Carson gana Nobel; escapará al bosque

en.title: Anne Carson wins Nobel; will escape to the forest
en.summary: Canadian poet Anne Carson learned of winning the Nobel Prize while cleaning her house. She offers guidance on approaching her work for the first time.

stories.title: Anne Carson, Nobel de Literatura 2026, analizó un concierto de Rosalía

en.title: Anne Carson, 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature winner, analyzed a Rosalía concert
en.summary: Anne Carson, the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature laureate, wrote about Rosalía's concert, noting how the artist explores femininity in her work.

stories.title: Explicador: ¿Qué distingue la obra de Anne Carson, ganadora del Nobel de Literatura 2026?

en.title: Explainer: What distinguishes Anne Carson's work, winner of the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature?
en.summary: Canadian writer Anne Carson won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature for work that engages with classical tradition and crosses literary genre boundaries, exploring love, desire, and loss through unconventional writing forms.

stories.title: Gana Anne Carson el Nobel de Literatura

en.title: Anne Carson Wins Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: Canadian author Anne Carson received the Nobel Prize in Literature for her work that dialogues with classical traditions and creates new forms for contemporary literature.

stories.title: Mexicana revela cuándo será rentable, suma una nueva ruta y va por 20 aviones para alcanzar esa meta

en.title: Mexican airline reveals when it will become profitable, adds new route and pursues 20 aircraft to reach that goal
en.summary: An airline executive presented a three-stage plan involving capacity expansion and the acquisition of 20 aircraft to achieve financial balance and profitability.

stories.title: Tormenta perfecta para el petróleo; huracán, guerra y bajas reservas disparan su precio 5%

en.title: Perfect storm for oil; hurricane, war and low reserves drive price up 5%
en.summary: Increased Middle East attacks and preventive production shutdowns in the Gulf of Mexico pushed Brent crude above 105 dollars, renewing concerns about persistent inflation.

stories.title: México, entre dos huracanes: Simón golpea el Pacífico e Isaias avanza por el Golfo; trayectoria y estados afectados

en.title: Mexico between two hurricanes: Simón strikes the Pacific and Isaias advances through the Gulf; trajectory and affected states
en.summary: Hurricanes Simón and Isaias are threatening different regions of Mexico, with one potentially reaching category 4 strength and the other strengthening to category 2 before moving away.

stories.title: Jitomate, cebolla y gas LP impulsan la inflación en México a 3.45% en septiembre

en.title: Tomatoes, onions and LP gas drive inflation in Mexico to 3.45% in September
en.summary: Mexico's annual inflation rose from 3.26% in August to 3.45%, slightly below analyst expectations, while the core inflation component decreased to 3.75%.

stories.title: ¿Quién es Anne Carson, la Nobel de Literatura 2026? Estas son las obras que la llevaron a ganar el premio

en.title: Who is Anne Carson, the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature winner? These are the works that led her to win the award
en.summary: Canadian writer Anne Carson was recognized for a career blending poetry, essays and classical tradition, with works exploring love, desire, loss and innovative storytelling forms.
